title: Soorata Jaarsa Hin Eegamne
intro: Mooraa qulqulluu Mana Rabbii keessatti maanguddoon gabricha Waaqayyoo tokko iccitii gadi fagoo kan eegamu hunda mormu mudate. Namni dhuunfaa of kenne kun, waggoota warra uumamaa yeroo dheeraa darbe, waan addaa araara daangaa hin qabne Waaqummaa mul’isu dhugaa ba’eera. Puzzle jireenya raajotaa irraa yeroo dagatame kana saaxiluudha.
clues: Sabni koo Israaʼel jedhamuun kan beekamu siʼa taʼu, sanyii abbaa durii isa guddaa ture.
Halkan koo mana qulqullummaa keessatti Gooftaa koo duratti sujuuduun kadhannaadhaan dabarse.
Umurii kootti ilmi naaf kenname, kennaa Rabbiif ulfina kennuu hin dhiisne.
Qormaanni koo rizqii lubbuu dargaggeessa kunuunsa koo jala jiruuf mulʼatu argachuu kan dabalatu ture.
Ani nabiyyii Zakariyyaa jedhamu, Bayt al-Maqdis keessatti Maryam kunuunsuuf itti kenname ture.
Deebiin isaa aayata Rabbiin Maariyaam itti qeebaluu fi rizqii isheef qopheesse keessa jira.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
